reason: A caller-side MCP bridge that orchestrates delegated work between Codex or Claude Code and DeepSeek Harness, including session observation, follow-up, cancellation, and human-gated interactions.

summaries.zh: 在 Codex 或 Claude Code 中通过 MCP 将任务委派给 DeepSeek Harness，并支持观察、继续、取消会话及处理人工交互。
summaries.en: An MCP bridge that lets Codex or Claude Code delegate work to DeepSeek Harness while observing, continuing, canceling, and handling human-gated session interactions.

capabilities: Creates and queues delegated tasks in DeepSeek Harness sessions
Observes session status and event digests
Handles pending questions and approval responses through typed MCP tools
Installs or updates caller MCP configuration during setup
